app_tagline: Read the objects inside the game's Unity bundles, right in your browser.
welcome_body: Drop bundles or a folder here, or choose them below. Files are read in this browser and never uploaded.
intro_lead: It isn't clear yet what this is useful for, but it can:
can_open: read bundles, or a whole folder of them, in this browser
can_browse: browse every bundle and object, filtered by name, class or path ID
can_bundle: show a bundle's entries, its classes and the bundles its externals resolve to
can_fields: show every field of an object, with references as links across bundles
can_referrers: show which objects refer to an object, and through which field
can_jump: jump anywhere with Ctrl K; back, forward and the URL keep your place
search_placeholder: Bundle, object name, class, container path or path ID
nothing_selected: Pick a bundle or an object in the library.
not_found: This place isn't among the open bundles. Open the same bundles to come back to it.
referenced_by_none: No open object refers to this one.
object_error: This object couldn't be read exactly
error_no_layout: The file has no type tree for this class, and no layout table covers it.
error_truncated: The layout reads past the end of the object.
error_trailing_bytes: The layout ends before the end of the object.
error_malformed: A stored value contradicts the file.
error_unresolved_reference_type: A managed reference names a type the file doesn't list.
error_obfuscation: The bundle header isn't one this tool knows.
about_privacy: Everything runs locally. Nothing is uploaded.
